title: 第 7 讲：疑问句、否定句与否定倒装

reading.title: Ask the Senior Dev

sentences.en: New joiners always ask me the same questions.
sentences.zh: 新同事总是问我同样的问题。

sentences.en: "How do you debug a bug you cannot reproduce?"
sentences.zh: "你怎么调试一个无法复现的 bug？"

sentences.en: Open the logs first; check the timeline, and never guess before you read.
sentences.zh: 先打开日志；核对时间线，读完之前永远不要瞎猜。

sentences.en: "What should you never do on a Friday afternoon?"
Never have I seen a calm Friday release — the universe loves to test us on weekends.
sentences.zh: 我从没见过一次平静的周五发布——宇宙就爱在周末考验我们。

sentences.en: Nobody knows everything; we just know where to look.
sentences.zh: 没人无所不知；我们只是知道去哪找答案。

sentences.en: Rarely does the first fix work, so keep three ideas in your pocket and run them one by one.
sentences.zh: 第一个修复很少能一次成功，所以口袋里备三个思路，挨个试。

sentences.en: And never skip code review: your future self will thank you.
sentences.zh: 还有：永远别跳过代码评审——未来的你会感谢现在的你。

reading.translation: 新同事总是问我同样的问题。"你怎么调试一个无法复现的 bug？"先打开日志；核对时间线，读完之前永远不要瞎猜。"周五下午永远不该做什么？"部署。我从没见过一次平静的周五发布——宇宙就爱在周末考验我们。"资深开发者无所不知吗？"不。没人无所不知；我们只是知道去哪找答案。第一个修复很少能一次成功，所以口袋里备三个思路，挨个试。还有：永远别跳过代码评审——未来的你会感谢现在的你。

keyPoints.sentence: How do you debug a bug?
keyPoints.analysis: 特殊疑问 = 疑问词 + 一般疑问语序（do + 主语 + 动词原形）

keyPoints.sentence: Never have I seen a calm Friday release.
keyPoints.analysis: 否定倒装：Never + 助动词 have + 主语 I + 过去分词；还原 = I have never seen...
nobody 否定主语 → 谓语用肯定式单数（L06 呼应）

keyPoints.sentence: Rarely does the first fix work.
keyPoints.analysis: rarely 否定副词前置 → 倒装 does + 主语 + work；还原 = The first fix rarely works.

core.collocations: reproduce the issue 复现问题

core.example: the universe loves to test us
keep three ideas in your pocket
core.collocations: in one's back pocket 备用

wordGroups.sentence: How do you debug a bug?

wordGroups.collocations: make a guess；a wild guess 瞎猜

wordGroups.sentence: your future self will thank you

practice.title: 句型转换 — 改为疑问句

questions.stem: She fixed the bug yesterday.（一般疑问）
answers: Did she fix the bug yesterday?
questions.explanation: 过去疑问用 did + 原形（fixed 还原为 fix）

questions.stem: The pipeline runs every hour.（对 every hour 提问 — 特殊疑问）
answers: How often does the pipeline run?
questions.explanation: every hour = 频率 → How often + does + 原形 run

questions.stem: Lin broke the build.（对 Lin 提问 — 主语疑问）
questions.explanation: 主语疑问不加 did（主语疑问句中动词保留过去式 broke）

questions.stem: The senior dev knows everything.（一般疑问）
answers: Does the senior dev know everything?
questions.explanation: 三单 does + 原形 know

questions.reference: How did you fix the cache?
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问 = 疑问词 + 一般疑问语序；did 后动词用原形 fix
nobody 单数，谓语肯定式三单

questions.stem: I never have seen such a clean log.
questions.reference: I have never seen such a clean log.（或倒装 Never have I seen...）
questions.explanation: never 要放在第一个助动词之后（have never seen）；原句把 never 放在助动词 have 之前是错误语序

practice.title: 倒装还原 — 把倒装句还原成平装语序

questions.stem: Rarely does a first draft compile.
Never have I deployed on Friday again.
answers: I have never deployed on Friday again.

practice.title: FAQ 写作 — 给新同事写 3 条 Q&A（1 条一般疑问 + 1 条特殊疑问 + 1 条含 Never have I 的回答）

questions.stem: 给新同事写 3 条 Q&A（1 条一般疑问 + 1 条特殊疑问 + 1 条含 Never have I 的回答）。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 一般疑问句以 Do/Does/Did 开头；特殊疑问句 = 疑问词 + 疑问语序；至少一处 Never have I + 过去分词

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: did 后动词是否还原为原形；倒装句能否还原回平装

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 3 条 Q&A 齐备，疑问句语序正确且倒装句可还原，即通过

practice.title: 互转 — 平装 ↔ 倒装 双向转换

questions.stem: 平装 → 倒装：I have never trusted a Friday deploy.
answers: Never have I trusted a Friday deploy.

questions.stem: 倒装 → 平装：Not only did the tests fail, but the build also broke.
answers: The tests not only failed, but the build also broke.
